caveats: Baseline window reported as the exact span of calendar days used to build the per-cell 90th-percentile thresholds and climatologies: baseline years 1992-2002 plus up to 5 days beyond each end (1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05) that fall inside the +/-5-day pools. Thresholds use MATLAB-quantile ('hazen') percentiles of +/-5-day day-of-year pools; day 60 set to mean of days 59/61; circular centred 31-day moving-mean smoothing; per-cell hot days are SST >= threshold, MHWs are >=5-day hot runs joined across gaps of 1-2 non-hot days; regional events are maximal runs of days with at least one sea cell in a per-cell MHW.
